timeout_policy: Use the returned legal move after a search timeout and record the timeout; an illegal move forfeits immediately; incomplete games are never counted.
random_seed_policy: Stable SHA-256 derivation from base_seed, the V4C game ID, move index, model, and player; all seeds are frozen before play.

algorithm_constraints.B: Pure Minimax with iterative deepening and deadline; no alpha-beta pruning.
algorithm_constraints.C: Same V4 evaluation, candidate set/order, and iterative-deepening search as B; only alpha-beta pruning enabled.
algorithm_constraints.D: V4B D2 pure UCT MCTS implementation and tactics/tree reuse unchanged; only time_limit_seconds changes from 20 to 50.

inference_limits.sample_size_warning: Six games per matchup and three paired opening blocks are exploratory; paired intervals are descriptive and not evidence of stable strength ranking.
inference_limits.compute_warning: D receives 50 seconds per move while B receives 1 second and C receives 0.2 seconds; this is intentionally unequal compute.
